name: Andou Chiwa
source:
"[i]Please be nicer to me, too. If you don't... I'll be upset. I'll keep hating you forever, senpai.[/i]"

Taiga’s childhood friend and his junior by one year.
She just enrolled at the same school as Taiga and the others this spring.

A [b]former magical girl[/b] who participated
in the grand battle several years back.
She currently lives with her father,
who runs an old café in town.
She doesn't belong to any clubs, and after school she works as a waitress at her father's shop.

Taiga is always teasing her, and she puffs up her cheeks saying how much she hates him,
but the truth is, she has been in love with Taiga for a long, long time.
She just can't be honest about it.

She loves cute things.
However, her sense of what she considers cute is a little... unusual.

She is also self-conscious about her small body.

[b]Profile[/b]
[i]Height[/i]: 145cm
[i]Measurements[/i]: B73 / W51 / H76
[i]Favorite food[/i]: Japanese sweets. Especially dango and ohagi.
[i]Blood type[/i]: A
[i]Birthday[/i]: May 2nd

[From official [url=https://kagamied.com/sakumoyu-en/]english website[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real time is 55 years before current time[/spoiler]
